p.src: 1  The LORD, you are my God. I will exalt you! I will praise your name, for you have done wonderful things, things planned long ago, in complete faithfulness and truth.

ja: をほめたたえる。あなたは不思議なことを行われた。遠い
en: The LORD, you are my God. I will exalt you! I will praise your name, for you have done wonderful things, things planned long ago, in complete faithfulness and truth.
u.src: 1  The LORD, you are my God. I will exalt you! I will praise your name, for you have done wonderful things, things planned long ago, in complete faithfulness and truth.

p.src: 2  For you have made a city into a heap, a fortified city into a ruin, a palace of strangers to be no city. It will never be built.

ja: を廃墟とされた。よそ者たちの
en: For you have made a city into a heap, a fortified city into a ruin, a palace of strangers to be no city. It will never be built.
u.src: 2  For you have made a city into a heap, a fortified city into a ruin, a palace of strangers to be no city. It will never be built.

p.src: 3  Therefore a strong people will glorify you. A city of awesome nations will fear you.

ja: はあなたに栄光を帰し、
en: Therefore a strong people will glorify you. A city of awesome nations will fear you.
u.src: 3  Therefore a strong people will glorify you. A city of awesome nations will fear you.

p.src: 4  For you have been a stronghold to the poor, a stronghold to the needy in his distress, a refuge from the storm, a shade from the heat, when the blast of the dreaded ones is like a storm against the wall.

ja: のとりで、困窮する者が
en: For you have been a stronghold to the poor, a stronghold to the needy in his distress, a refuge from the storm, a shade from the heat, when the blast of the dreaded ones is like a storm against the wall.
u.src: 4  For you have been a stronghold to the poor, a stronghold to the needy in his distress, a refuge from the storm, a shade from the heat, when the blast of the dreaded ones is like a storm against the wall.

p.src: 5  As the heat in a dry place you will bring down the noise of strangers; as the heat by the shade of a cloud, the song of the dreaded ones will be brought low.

ja: めるように、あなたはよそ者たちの騒ぎを静められた。
en: As the heat in a dry place you will bring down the noise of strangers; as the heat by the shade of a cloud, the song of the dreaded ones will be brought low.
u.src: 5  As the heat in a dry place you will bring down the noise of strangers; as the heat by the shade of a cloud, the song of the dreaded ones will be brought low.

p.src: 6  In this mountain, the LORD of Armies will make all peoples a feast of choice meat, a feast of choice wines, of choice meat full of marrow, of well refined choice wines.

ja: のために、選りすぐった肉の
を催される。髄に満ちた選りすぐった肉と、よくこされた上等なぶどう酒の宴である。
en: In this mountain, the LORD of Armies will make all peoples a feast of choice meat, a feast of choice wines, of choice meat full of marrow, of well refined choice wines.
u.src: 6  In this mountain, the LORD of Armies will make all peoples a feast of choice meat, a feast of choice wines, of choice meat full of marrow, of well refined choice wines.

ja: 25:6 直訳では「脂肪の多いもの」。

p.src: 7  He will destroy in this mountain the surface of the covering that covers all peoples, and the veil that is spread over all nations.

en: He will destroy in this mountain the surface of the covering that covers all peoples, and the veil that is spread over all nations.
u.src: 7  He will destroy in this mountain the surface of the covering that covers all peoples, and the veil that is spread over all nations.

p.src: 8  He has swallowed up death forever! The Lord GOD will wipe away tears from off all faces. He will take the reproach of his people away from off all the earth, for the LORD has spoken it.

en: He has swallowed up death forever! The Lord GOD will wipe away tears from off all faces. He will take the reproach of his people away from off all the earth, for the LORD has spoken it.
u.src: 8  He has swallowed up death forever! The Lord GOD will wipe away tears from off all faces. He will take the reproach of his people away from off all the earth, for the LORD has spoken it.

p.src: 9  It shall be said in that day, “Behold, this is our God! We have waited for him, and he will save us! This is the LORD! We have waited for him. We will be glad and rejoice in his salvation!”

ja: よ、この方こそわれわれの
ってくださる。この方こそ主。われわれはこの
en: It shall be said in that day, “Behold, this is our God! We have waited for him, and he will save us! This is the LORD! We have waited for him. We will be glad and rejoice in his salvation!”
u.src: 9  It shall be said in that day, “Behold, this is our God! We have waited for him, and he will save us! This is the LORD! We have waited for him. We will be glad and rejoice in his salvation!”

p.src: 10  For the LORD’s hand will rest in this mountain. Moab will be trodden down in his place, even like straw is trodden down in the water of the dunghill.

ja: にとどまる。 モアブはその
みつけられるように踏みつけられる。
en: For the LORD’s hand will rest in this mountain. Moab will be trodden down in his place, even like straw is trodden down in the water of the dunghill.
u.src: 10  For the LORD’s hand will rest in this mountain. Moab will be trodden down in his place, even like straw is trodden down in the water of the dunghill.

p.src: 11  He will spread out his hands in the middle of it, like one who swims spreads out hands to swim, but his pride will be humbled together with the craft of his hands.

ja: を広げるように、モアブはその中で両手を広げる。しかし、
en: He will spread out his hands in the middle of it, like one who swims spreads out hands to swim, but his pride will be humbled together with the craft of his hands.
u.src: 11  He will spread out his hands in the middle of it, like one who swims spreads out hands to swim, but his pride will be humbled together with the craft of his hands.

p.src: 12  He has brought the high fortress of your walls down, laid low, and brought to the ground, even to the dust.

ja: に、ちりにまで打ち倒す。
en: He has brought the high fortress of your walls down, laid low, and brought to the ground, even to the dust.
u.src: 12  He has brought the high fortress of your walls down, laid low, and brought to the ground, even to the dust.
